entry.title: Michael’s Gate
entry.note: The nearly square exact-identity footprint and the Michalská through-passage determine a directed frame: authored +Z faces south-southeast into the old city. The mapped long axis is rotated by pi/2 so the passage, rather than the side wall, follows the street. Attached townhouses, including the narrow neighbouring house, retain separate map footprints. Only the gate tower itself is included. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
